Initial viewport assertions compared physical window pixels against the expanded 1280-unit canvas. The focused fixture now disables its canvas scale and waits for actual logical resizing; assertions were retained.

One early integrated attempt stopped on a concurrent ConditionStore initialization/flush error. Refreshing imports after concurrent storage source updates restored the full existing suite; no storage source was changed by this task.
A later root run caught a concurrent TrackCompiler six-argument call before NativeTrack was updated. Both files were left untouched; all final runs use the current matching source.

Invitation minimum width came from the native action row; Share invite fits narrow windows. A zero-width wrapped subtitle inflated initial dialog height; concise unwrapped copy removed that expansion. Narrow headers use a smaller font.
Picker widths and car art adapt to narrow/short windows; the final focused checks cover both portrait and short landscape pickers.
